detail.abstract:
The global Pay TV market has shed over 25% of its subscriber base since 2017, and OTT delivery has become the dominant medium for video consumption worldwide. This structural shift has transformed encoding infrastructure from a back-office cost centre into a first-order competitive variable — one where the wrong decision translates directly into tens of millions of dollars in avoidable CDN expenditure, degraded viewer experience, and technical debt that compounds with every hour of content ever encoded.

The economic stakes are stark. A 3-year total cost of ownership (TCO) analysis presented in this paper demonstrates that purpose-built ASIC-based encoding deployments achieve up to 99% cost reduction per channel compared to managed cloud solutions such as AWS Elemental MediaLive — not through compromise, but through intelligent infrastructure alignment. The crossover inflection point between next-generation chip-based systems and legacy appliance architectures has already been crossed for AV1 live encoding, and is arriving for VVC offline VOD in 2026.

Artificial intelligence is the defining force reshaping this landscape. Machine learning has moved from experimental overlay to production requirement across every layer of the encoding pipeline: VMAF-guided rate-distortion optimization delivers 20% bitrate reduction at equivalent perceptual quality; content-adaptive bitrate laddering uses ML complexity analysis to generate per-title and per-scene encoding profiles; reinforcement learning ABR algorithms optimize Quality of Experience in real time; and neural codec architectures are achieving compression efficiency 20-40% beyond VVC on select content categories. The transition from QoS-centric to QoE-driven service performance assessment [3] is redefining the very metrics against which encoding systems are evaluated.

To navigate these converging forces, this paper introduces the Codec-Infrastructure Alignment Matrix (CIAM) — a four-dimensional engineering decision framework mapping encoder technologies across performance throughput, feature richness, AI integration readiness, and economic profile. We conduct a deep technical assessment of the 2026 codec landscape (AV1, VVC/H.266, LCEVC, neural codecs), benchmark four hardware architecture classes (CPU, GPU, FPGA, ASIC), and provide a structured hybrid deployment reference architecture for OTT operators at every scale. Building on prior strategic work in OTT encoding [1] and product lifecycle intelligence [2], this paper delivers the engineering rigour that infrastructure decisions at CDN scale demand.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了全球付费电视市场向OTT转型背景下，编码基础设施从成本中心转变为关键竞争变量的过程。通过TCO分析发现ASIC编码比云解决方案成本降低99%，并引入Codec-Infrastructure Alignment Matrix框架，评估2026年编码技术格局和硬件架构，为OTT运营商提供部署参考架构。
AI.research_question: 在OTT视频消费主导的背景下，如何通过编码基础设施的技术和经济优化来降低CDN成本、提升观看体验并减少技术债务？
AI.motivation: 全球付费电视市场自2017年以来流失超过25%用户，OTT已成为视频消费主导方式。编码基础设施从后台成本中心转变为一级竞争变量，错误决策会导致数千万美元可避免的CDN支出、观看体验下降和技术债务累积。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 编码基础设施经济学：TCO分析框架；2. 技术采纳曲线理论；3. AI驱动的编码优化理论；4. Codec-Infrastructure Alignment Matrix（CIAM）四维工程决策框架
AI.method: 1. 3年TCO对比分析（ASIC vs AWS Elemental MediaLive）；2. 技术基准测试（AV1、VVC/H.266、LCEVC、神经编码器）；3. 硬件架构评估（CPU、GPU、FPGA、ASIC）；4. 混合部署参考架构设计
AI.findings: 1. ASIC编码比云解决方案成本降低99%；2. AV1实时编码已跨越芯片系统与遗留架构的拐点；3. AI在编码各层实现显著优化：VMAF指导的率失真优化减少20%码率，ML复杂度分析实现按标题/场景编码，RL ABR算法实时优化QoE；4. 神经编码器在特定内容上压缩效率比VVC高20-40%
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出Codec-Infrastructure Alignment Matrix（CIAM）四维工程决策框架；2. 建立从QoS到QoE的服务性能评估范式转变理论；3. 完善编码基础设施经济学分析框架
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为OTT运营商提供结构化混合部署参考架构；2. 提供2026年编码技术格局的深度技术评估；3. 给出硬件架构选择的经济和技术指导；4. 帮助运营商避免数千万美元CDN支出和技术债务

title: Mapping the Midweek Mountain: The New Geography of Hybrid Work
affiliations: Saint Louis University - Department of Finance, Emory University Goizueta Business School,  and Georgia State University - J. Mack Robinson College of Business

detail.title: Mapping the Midweek Mountain: The New Geography of Hybrid Work
detail.abstract: This paper provides a behavioral analysis of the post-pandemic transformation of work, using a dataset of approximately 41 billion mobile geolocation records from 73.5 million individuals in the five largest U.S. metropolitan areas from the pre-to post- pandemic periods. By tracking movements between corporate headquarters, residences, and other points of interest, we document a structural shift in work patterns. Office based workdays declined from 42% in 2019 to 20.7% in 2022, before settling at 29.1% in 2023, a new equilibrium significantly below pre-pandemic levels. A "midweek mountain" peak of office attendance on Tuesdays through Thursdays, emerged as a robust new phenomenon post-pandemic. The nature of remote work has also changed: both in and after the pandemic, employees working from home allocated significantly more time to non-work locations like parks and malls during the workday. These findings indicate that the pandemic catalyzed a lasting transformation not just in work arrangements but also in the integration of personal and professional life, with implications for corporate policy, urban economics, and the future of work.

AI.tldr: 基于410亿条移动地理位置数据的研究显示，疫情后工作模式发生结构性转变：办公室工作日比例从2019年的42%降至2023年的29.1%，形成"周中高峰"新现象，远程工作者在工作日更多前往公园、商场等非工作场所。
AI.research_question: 疫情如何改变了美国大城市的工作模式？远程工作的新常态是什么？工作与个人生活的整合发生了怎样的变化？
AI.motivation: 疫情对工作模式产生了深远影响，但缺乏大规模实证数据来量化这种转变的程度和特征，需要理解工作安排的结构性变化及其对城市经济和企业政策的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为经济学、城市经济学、工作安排理论、远程工作理论、工作-生活平衡理论
AI.method: 使用约410亿条移动地理位置记录，追踪7350万个体在美国五大都市区从疫情前到疫情后的移动模式，分析公司总部、住宅和其他兴趣点之间的移动模式。
AI.findings: 1. 办公室工作日比例从2019年的42%降至2022年的20.7%，2023年稳定在29.1%；2. 出现"周中高峰"现象（周二至周四办公室出勤率最高）；3. 远程工作者在工作日更多前往公园、商场等非工作场所；4. 疫情催化了工作安排的持久转变。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了疫情后工作模式转变的实证证据；2. 识别了"周中高峰"这一新现象；3. 揭示了远程工作行为的变化特征；4. 为工作-生活整合理论提供了新的视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为企业制定混合工作政策提供依据；2. 为城市规划者理解城市空间利用变化提供参考；3. 帮助政策制定者应对工作模式转变带来的经济影响；4. 为房地产、交通等相关行业提供决策支持。

title: Measuring Machine-Performed Labor: A Framework for Quantifying AI Work Using Human-Equivalent Work Units (HEWU)

detail.title: Measuring Machine-Performed Labor: A Framework for Quantifying AI Work Using Human-Equivalent Work Units (HEWU)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder of AnthroMetrics AI, the platform described in this paper. The research reflects the author’s work on developing a framework for measuring AI-driven labor. No other competing financial or personal relationships are declared.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants, patient data, or personal data. No ethical approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was conducted independently and did not receive any external funding.

detail.abstract:
Artificial intelligence systems are transitioning from narrow productivity tools into autonomous agents capable of performing economically meaningful work at scale. They resolve customer issues, write and review code, process documents, manage logistics, and operate physical machinery — continuously, and at a volume no human workforce can replicate.

Yet this labor force is entirely invisible to the economic infrastructure humanity has built to measure work. No standard unit of measurement exists. No index tracks machine labor output over time. No regulatory framework requires its disclosure. The result is a growing and consequential blind spot at the intersection of technology, economics, and public policy.

AnthroMetrics AI introduces the Human-Equivalent Work Unit (HEWU) — a standardized metric that converts AI and automation system output into human labor equivalents, expressed in full-time employee (FTE) equivalents and annual labor value ($). This paper presents the conceptual foundation, mathematical framework, calibration methodology, system architecture, and institutional implications of HEWU and its companion metric AILU (AI Labor Units). It further introduces the Machine Labor Index (HEWU-PSI), a time-series economic indicator designed to track aggregate machine labor output at the company, sector, and national level.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种衡量AI劳动产出的标准化度量体系，包括人类等效工作单位（HEWU）、AI劳动单位（AILU）和机器劳动指数（HEWU-PSI），以解决当前经济体系中AI劳动不可见的问题。
AI.research_question: 如何建立标准化度量体系来量化AI和自动化系统的劳动产出，使其能够被纳入现有的经济测量框架中？
AI.motivation: AI系统正从狭窄的生产力工具转变为能够大规模执行经济意义工作的自主代理，但当前经济基础设施无法测量这种机器劳动，导致技术、经济和公共政策交叉领域存在重大盲点。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于劳动经济学、生产力测量理论和标准化度量框架，将AI劳动产出转化为人类劳动等效值，建立可比较的测量体系。
AI.method: 开发了HEWU（人类等效工作单位）的概念基础、数学框架、校准方法、系统架构，以及AILU（AI劳动单位）和HEWU-PSI（机器劳动指数）作为配套指标。
AI.findings: 提出了完整的AI劳动测量体系，包括：1）HEWU将AI产出转化为FTE等效值和年度劳动价值；2）AILU作为基础计量单位；3）HEWU-PSI作为追踪公司、行业和国家层面机器劳动产出的时间序列经济指标。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地建立了AI劳动的经济测量理论框架，填补了劳动经济学在机器劳动量化方面的理论空白，为AI经济学奠定了基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、企业和研究人员提供了实际可用的AI劳动测量工具，支持监管披露要求、经济政策制定、企业AI投资决策和劳动力市场分析。

title: Knowledge Updating as Triadic Instability
affiliations: Foods Support MORICA Co., Ltd.

detail.title: Knowledge Updating as Triadic Instability

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests (financial or non-financial) that could be perceived to influence this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: No human participants, personal data, or identifiable information were involved. Therefore, ethics approval and informed consent were not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
Organizations can accumulate knowledge—manuals, training programs, meetings, and shared documents—and yet fail to learn: the same class of problems reappears in altered forms, exceptions proliferate, and responsibility remains suspended. This paper reframes the phenomenon as structural closure: the knowledge loop becomes statically closed even as repetition continues. The common managerial move is to attribute stagnation to individuals; as a result, structural updates to operations, boundaries, responsibility, and consequences recede into the background.

To counter this closure, I introduce an implementable procedure (observation → description → adjudication → reconfiguration), an operational design for exception handling, and observable metrics (question classification, an A/B/C exception funnel, recurrence rate, and decision-table fixation rate, etc.) to secure falsifiability.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨组织知识积累却无法学习的现象，将其定义为"结构闭合"，并提出可实施的程序、操作设计和可观察指标来打破这种闭合。
AI.research_question: 为什么组织积累了知识（手册、培训、会议、共享文档）却仍然无法学习，导致同类问题反复出现？
AI.motivation: 组织经常面临知识积累与学习脱节的困境：问题重复出现、例外情况增多、责任悬而未决，而管理者往往将停滞归咎于个人而非结构性问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构闭合理论（structural closure）：知识循环在重复中保持静态闭合，导致组织无法真正学习。
AI.method: 提出可实施的四步程序（观察→描述→裁决→重构），设计例外处理的操作框架，并建立可观察指标（问题分类、A/B/C例外漏斗、复发率、决策表固定率等）。
AI.findings: 组织学习停滞的根本原因是结构闭合而非个人能力问题；通过系统性的程序设计和可验证指标可以打破这种闭合。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出"结构闭合"概念框架解释组织学习失败现象；2) 将组织学习问题从个体归因转向结构分析；3) 建立可证伪的组织学习理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提供可操作的四步实施程序；2) 设计例外处理的操作框架；3) 建立可测量的组织学习指标体系；4) 为管理者提供打破结构闭合的具体工具。

title: LGPD Compliance for U.S. Investment Advisers with Brazilian Client Exposure: Navigating The Regulatory Gap Between the Bank Secrecy Act and Brazil's Data Protection Framework

detail.title: LGPD Compliance for U.S. Investment Advisers with Brazilian Client Exposure: Navigating The Regulatory Gap Between the Bank Secrecy Act and Brazil's Data Protection Framework

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests. No personal or financial relationship with any person or organization has influenced or could be perceived to have influenced this study. The author is the founder and director of Kadima Holding, an independent advisory firm. The analysis presented in this paper reflects the author's independent research and does not represent the views or interests of any client, regulatory body, or third party.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study is a regulatory and legal analysis based exclusively on publicly available legislative texts, regulatory documents, and official government publications. No human participants, patient data, or personal data were collected or used in this research.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The study was conducted independently by the author with no financial support from any public, commercial, or nonprofit funding agency.

detail.abstract: The August 2024 FinCEN final rule extending anti-money laundering and countering the financing of terrorism obligations to SEC-registered investment advisers (89 Fed. Reg. 72,156) creates an underexamined compliance problem for the advisers now subject to its requirements. Although the rule's effective date was subsequently delayed to January 1, 2028, and FinCEN has indicated it will revisit the rule's scope, the underlying data obligations remain operative for compliance planning purposes. Advisers with Brazilian client exposure must simultaneously satisfy Bank Secrecy Act customer identification and suspicious activity reporting obligations and Brazil's Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados (LGPD), Law No. 13,709/2018. These two frameworks impose conflicting obligations on data collection, retention, and cross-border transfer that existing compliance guidance does not resolve. This paper identifies the specific conflicts, analyzes the legal basis for each, and proposes a bilateral compliance framework that satisfies both regulatory regimes without requiring advisers to choose between them. The analysis draws on the U.S.-Brazil Commercial Dialogue Action Plan 2024–2025, which identifies privacy and data protection as a priority area for bilateral cooperation, and argues that the resolution of this compliance gap is both operationally necessary and consistent with stated bilateral policy objectives.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了美国FinCEN反洗钱规则与巴西LGPD数据保护法对投资顾问产生的合规冲突，提出了满足双重监管框架的双边合规解决方案。
AI.research_question: 美国SEC注册投资顾问如何同时满足FinCEN反洗钱规则和巴西LGPD数据保护法的冲突性合规要求？
AI.motivation: FinCEN 2024年最终规则将反洗钱义务扩展到投资顾问，与巴西LGPD数据保护法在数据收集、保留和跨境传输方面存在冲突，现有合规指南无法解决这一矛盾。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 监管冲突理论：分析不同司法管辖区法律框架之间的冲突；2. 合规风险管理理论；3. 数据保护与金融监管平衡理论；4. 双边合作框架理论。
AI.method: 1. 法律文本分析：比较FinCEN规则和巴西LGPD的具体条款；2. 冲突识别：识别数据收集、保留、跨境传输的具体冲突点；3. 法律基础分析：分析各监管要求的法律依据；4. 框架构建：基于美巴商业对话行动计划提出双边合规框架。
AI.findings: 1. FinCEN要求客户识别和可疑活动报告与LGPD的数据最小化、目的限制原则冲突；2. 数据保留期限要求不一致；3. 跨境数据传输限制与反洗钱信息共享要求冲突；4. 现有合规指南无法提供同时满足两种制度的解决方案。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 发展了跨境金融监管冲突理论；2. 提出了数据保护与反洗钱监管协调的理论框架；3. 丰富了双边合规机制的理论基础；4. 为多司法管辖区合规研究提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为投资顾问提供了具体的合规冲突识别工具；2. 提出了可操作的双边合规框架；3. 基于美巴商业对话行动计划提供了政策实施路径；4. 为其他面临类似冲突的金融机构提供了参考模板。

title: Minimal Intelligence in the Double Auction: Logit-Choice and Reservation Utility
affiliations: University of New South Wales

detail.title: Minimal Intelligence in the Double Auction: Logit-Choice and Reservation Utility

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: Data from Friedman et al. (2025) and Williams (2025a) are from experiments conducted under human subjects protocol, HS3566, approved by the IRB of UCSC.
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: I propose a new boundedly-rational trader-behavior model for the continuous double auction, fit in the general equilibrium (GE) framework. Traders' order placement and acceptance strategies are driven by GE-adaptions of two classic mechanisms: within-period reservation prices (here utilities), and price-acceptability beliefs. Traders use probabilistic choice over their set of admissible orders, based on beliefs formed about the acceptability of each order. The logit choice parameter allows the precision of trader order placement to range from zero intelligence to perfectly maximizing given beliefs. Simulations report market performance for this model, finding promising measures of efficiency and evidence of convergence to nearly Pareto optimal allocations. The model is then applied to experimental data from Williams (2025a) and Friedman et al. (2025), capturing an encouraging amount of the utility-reducing behavior and order placement in general.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的有限理性交易者行为模型，适用于连续双向拍卖市场，并融入一般均衡框架。该模型通过一般均衡调整的保留价格（效用）和价格可接受性信念来驱动交易者的订单提交和接受策略，使用概率选择机制，从零智能到完美最大化信念的精度范围可调。模拟显示市场效率良好，接近帕累托最优分配。模型应用于实验数据，能有效捕捉效用减少行为和订单提交模式。
AI.research_question: 如何在一般均衡框架下构建一个有限理性的交易者行为模型来模拟连续双向拍卖市场的运作？
AI.motivation: 现有市场模型往往假设完全理性或零智能交易者，缺乏对有限理性行为的现实描述。需要开发一个既能融入一般均衡理论，又能捕捉真实交易者有限理性特征的行为模型。
AI.theoretical_framework: 一般均衡理论、有限理性理论、连续双向拍卖市场机制、概率选择理论（logit模型）、保留价格理论、信念形成机制
AI.method: 理论模型构建与计算机模拟分析。首先提出基于一般均衡调整的保留价格（效用）和价格可接受性信念的交易者行为模型，使用logit概率选择机制。然后通过模拟分析市场性能，最后将模型应用于Williams (2025a)和Friedman et al. (2025)的实验数据进行验证。
AI.findings: 模拟结果显示该模型能产生良好的市场效率指标，并收敛到接近帕累托最优的分配。应用于实验数据时，模型能有效捕捉到相当程度的效用减少行为和订单提交模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将有限理性交易者行为融入一般均衡框架；2) 提出基于一般均衡调整的保留价格和信念机制的交易策略；3) 构建从零智能到完美理性的连续行为谱系；4) 为连续双向拍卖市场提供新的行为微观基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为市场设计者提供更现实的模拟工具；2) 帮助理解真实交易者的有限理性行为；3) 可用于预测市场效率和收敛性；4) 为实验经济学提供理论解释框架。

title: Government as Systematic Participant: Automated Tax Allocation Mechanisms for Sustainable Poverty Reduction Financing
affiliations: University of Colombo

detail.title: Government as Systematic Participant: Automated Tax Allocation Mechanisms for Sustainable Poverty Reduction Financing
detail.abstract:
This working paper establishes the fourth pillar of the Network-Enabled Market Optimization (NEMO) framework: government as systematic participant rather than passive regulator or discretionary funder. Conventional government involvement in poverty reduction programs reproduces structural fragility by positioning public budgets as appropriations competing annually against alternative expenditure priorities. The NEMO Government Participation Framework proposes automated percentage allocation from existing tax revenue streams (Value Added Tax, Corporate Income Tax, Personal Income Tax, Employee Provident Fund, and Employee Trust Fund), transforming government contribution from discretionary expenditure into an inherent component of revenue collection.

The paper presents mathematical architecture for the government pillar across six operational domains: tax allocation automation protocols, EPF and ETF monthly distribution calculations, daily Participation Value Credit (PVC) price reduction algorithms, SME formalization incentive structures, actuarial Social Impact Credit (SIC) distribution modulation incorporating winning history, age, and geographic factors, and zero-value PVC economic implications. Each domain receives rigorous treatment through De Bono's Six Thinking Hats methodology (Nadhir, 2026a) ensuring analytical completeness across factual, emotional, risk, benefit, creative, and synthesis dimensions.

The central finding demonstrates that automated tax allocation at 2 percent of specified revenue streams produces daily government contribution of approximately LKR 24.66 million under Sri Lankan fiscal conditions, sufficient to reduce PVC prices by 34 to 35 percent across all three tiers daily while maintaining actuarially sound SIC distribution. The formalization incentive analysis shows SME formalization under NEMO access generates revenue increases offsetting 61 percent of income reduction from tax compliance costs, with full break-even achievable when merchant network density reaches threshold scale. This creates a self-reinforcing fiscal cycle: government contribution incentivizes formal participation, formal participation expands the tax base, expanded tax base increases government contribution capacity.

The paper situates these mechanisms within public finance theory (Musgrave and Musgrave, 1989; Stiglitz, 2000), behavioural economics of participation (Thaler and Sunstein, 2008; Kahneman, 2011), and development economics literature on cash transfer sustainability (Banerjee et al., 2015; World Bank, 2025). It concludes that automated allocation represents a structurally superior mechanism by removing NEMO from annual budget competition, creating explicit fiscal incentives for government success, and generating formalization feedback loops that increase contribution capacity over time.

AI.tldr: 该工作论文提出了NEMO框架的第四支柱：政府作为系统性参与者而非被动监管者或自由裁量资助者。通过从现有税收流中自动分配2%的资金，政府贡献从自由裁量支出转变为收入征收的内在组成部分，创造了一个自我强化的财政循环。
AI.research_question: 如何将政府从贫困减少项目中的被动监管者/自由裁量资助者角色转变为系统性参与者，通过自动税收分配创造可持续的财政循环？
AI.motivation: 传统的政府参与贫困减少项目存在结构性脆弱性，因为公共预算作为年度拨款与其他支出优先事项竞争。这种安排使减贫项目面临资金不稳定和可持续性挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公共财政理论（Musgrave和Musgrave，1989；Stiglitz，2000）、参与行为经济学（Thaler和Sunstein，2008；Kahneman，2011）、发展经济学中的现金转移可持续性文献（Banerjee等，2015；世界银行，2025）
AI.method: 使用De Bono的六顶思考帽方法（Nadhir，2026a）对六个操作领域进行数学架构分析：税收分配自动化协议、EPF和ETF月度分配计算、每日PVC价格降低算法、中小企业正规化激励结构、精算SIC分配调制、零值PVC经济影响
AI.findings: 在斯里兰卡财政条件下，特定收入流2%的自动税收分配每天产生约2466万卢比的政府贡献，足以使所有三个层级的PVC价格每日降低34-35%。中小企业正规化在NEMO访问下产生的收入增加抵消了61%的税收合规成本收入减少，当商户网络密度达到阈值规模时可实现完全盈亏平衡。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了政府作为系统性参与者的新理论框架，将政府贡献从自由裁量支出重新概念化为收入征收的内在组成部分。建立了自动税收分配与正规化反馈循环之间的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了具体的数学架构和操作协议，使政府能够实施自动税收分配。展示了如何通过正规化激励创造自我强化的财政循环：政府贡献激励正规参与，正规参与扩大税基，扩大税基增加政府贡献能力。

title: A Systematic Review of Rationality (Concept, Classification, Opinions and Views of experts) in Social Sciences with Emphasis on Management
affiliations: and Research Institute of Hawzah and University

detail.title: A Systematic Review of Rationality (Concept, Classification, Opinions and Views of experts) in Social Sciences with Emphasis on Management
detail.abstract:
Introduction and Objectives: Rationality is a fundamental concept in philosophy, natural sciences, and social sciences that plays a role in both theoretical and applied dimensions. “Reason” has undergone a transformation in its historical course from theoretical reason in the “Platonic-Aristotelian tradition” to modern instrumental reason. The concept of rationality as one of the central concepts in the humanities has complex dimensions and is derived from the French language (Arastekho, 2002, p. 681); however, “rationality” or “rational aspects” has many derivatives, all of which are derived from this word. Rationalization is a process by which realities and activities are placed within the scope of the dominance of reason. In fact, rationality is considered to be meaningful in a specific context (Turner, 2006: 145). Therefore, it can be said that a rational act is an act that convinces and convinces the power of reason or human reasoning; In this sense, reasoning is based on thinking and is different from feelings and emotions (Danaeifard et al., 2010; quoted by Snellen). One of the major challenges that researchers and theorists in this field face is the lack of a unified understanding of the concept of rationality and its related aspects. In general, the main question of this research is: “What is rationality and the aspects related to what has characteristics?”; The purpose of this research is to provide the audience with a better understanding of various aspects of rationality by relying on the study and collection of literature and theoretical background in the field of social sciences.

Research Method: In the field of applied research, there are several methods, each of which may be assigned different names depending on the characteristics of the research questions and the specific situations and conditions of the study. The most important of these studies are: case studies, historical, descriptive, exploratory, longitudinal and cross-sectional, field, laboratory, experimental and post-event, correlational and congruent, real and quasi-experimental. Descriptive research method is one of the most basic forms of research. This research, at the bottom of the research hierarchy pyramid and with a descriptive-analytical approach, examines rationality in terms of its application in social sciences. The fact that descriptive research is at the bottom of the research pyramid does not mean that it is unimportant, unscientific or worthless. This type of research describes phenomena in our world. These descriptions can be about basic information, activities, behaviors and fundamental changes in phenomena. The present research is of a descriptive-analytical type and has attempted to examine the concept of rationality and the issues and phenomena related to it with a systematic approach. In this direction, the views and opinions of prominent scholars in this field and their analysis and classification have been the researchers’ approach in this research. The main goal of this research is to accurately describe the concept of rationality, the opinions and views of experts in the field of rationality and related concepts.

Research findings: First, different categories of rationality were presented, which were defined in different ways, depending on the differences in symbols, values, and culture of different societies.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了"理性"这一概念在哲学、自然科学和社会科学中的演变与应用，通过描述性分析方法梳理了理性的不同维度及其在社会科学中的意义。
AI.research_question: 什么是理性及其相关方面具有什么特征？
AI.motivation: 理性作为人文社会科学的核心概念具有复杂维度，但研究者面临缺乏统一理解的挑战。该研究旨在通过文献综述提供对理性不同方面的更好理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于柏拉图-亚里士多德传统的理论理性到现代工具理性的历史演变；理性在不同社会文化背景下的多样性理解。
AI.method: 描述性分析方法，系统梳理和分类该领域知名学者的观点和意见。
AI.findings: 理性存在不同分类，这些分类因不同社会的符号、价值观和文化差异而以不同方式定义。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统梳理了理性的概念演变和不同维度，为理解这一复杂概念提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为社会科学研究者提供了对理性概念的更清晰理解，有助于跨学科研究和实践应用。

title: Condemning the University of Leicester - Standing for Political Economy and Critical Management Studies

detail.title: Condemning the University of Leicester - Standing for Political Economy and Critical Management Studies
detail.abstract: In January 2021, in the midst of a deadly pandemic, the University of Leicester decided to place dozens of academic and professional staff at risk of redundancy, including scholars in Critical Management Studies and Political Economy. This decision, introduced under the "Shaping for Excellence" plan, appears to target individuals based on the content and focus of their research rather than their performance, raising concerns about academic freedom and due process, while several of the affected staff are also union representatives with strong scholarly reputations. These managerialist and neoliberal measures undermine the integrity of the School of Business and the future of critical scholarship in academia. The ES/PE community firmly calls for the abandonment of this scheme, noting that its timing is brutal, its process opaque, and its substance more than questionable.

AI.tldr: 莱斯特大学在疫情期间以"塑造卓越"计划为名，针对批判管理研究和政治经济学学者进行裁员，威胁学术自由和正当程序，引发学界强烈反对。
AI.research_question: 大学管理层基于研究内容和政治立场而非学术表现进行裁员决策，如何影响学术自由、正当程序和批判学术的未来？
AI.motivation: 在致命疫情中，莱斯特大学针对批判管理研究和政治经济学学者进行裁员，这种基于研究内容而非绩效的决策威胁学术自由，需要分析其影响和后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 批判管理研究、政治经济学、学术自由理论、管理主义、新自由主义高等教育改革、正当程序原则
AI.method: 批判性案例分析，基于公开声明和事件描述，分析大学裁员决策的制度背景、正当性问题和学术自由影响
AI.findings: 裁员决策基于研究内容而非绩效，时机残酷、过程不透明、实质可疑，针对批判学者和工会代表，威胁学术自由和批判学术未来
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了新自由主义管理主义如何通过裁员策略压制批判学术，扩展了学术自由威胁机制的理论理解，提供了管理主义侵蚀学术自主性的实证案例
AI.practical_contributions: 呼吁放弃该裁员计划，保护学术自由和正当程序，为其他面临类似威胁的学术机构提供警示，促进对大学管理决策透明度和正当性的监督

title: Restoring the First Rule: Structural Distance in Problem-Driven Organizational Search
affiliations: and ESSEC Business School

detail.title: Restoring the First Rule: Structural Distance in Problem-Driven Organizational Search
detail.abstract: The Carnegie School proposes that problem-driven organizational search follows two simple rules of locality: search begins where the problem first occurred and close to the prior solution. While the literature has extensively examined the latter, the former dimension of search remains largely unexplored. The question we tackle in this paper is whether it matters where in the organizational structure search occurs, or only what solutions are explored. We formally examine the performance implications of structural distance, which is the distance between where the problem originated in the organization and where search occurs, and compare them to those of solution distance, which is the degree to which a new solution differs from the prior one. We find that, from a search efficacy point of view, structural distance is often more consequential than solution distance, and the relative importance of each depends critically on the pattern of task interdependence. As interdependence increases, structural distance becomes increasingly important and can even substitute for insufficient solution exploration, while the converse does not hold. We also explore conditions under which exploration on both dimensions benefits search. These findings suggest that the dominant focus on solution distance may have overlooked a comparably important dimension of organizational search, with implications for how we understand the internal dynamics of problem-driven search and the relationship between organizational structure and adaptation.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现，在组织搜索中，结构距离（问题起源位置与搜索发生位置之间的距离）往往比解决方案距离（新方案与旧方案的差异程度）更重要，特别是在任务相互依赖性高的情况下。
AI.research_question: 在组织搜索中，是搜索发生的位置重要，还是探索的解决方案内容重要？结构距离和解决方案距离哪个对搜索效果影响更大？
AI.motivation: 卡内基学派提出组织搜索遵循两个局部性规则：搜索从问题首次发生的地方开始，并接近先前的解决方案。现有文献广泛研究了后者，但对前者（搜索发生的位置）关注不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 卡内基学派的组织搜索理论，特别是问题驱动搜索的局部性规则。关注结构距离和解决方案距离两个维度。
AI.method: 正式分析（formal examination）结构距离和解决方案距离对搜索绩效的影响，特别关注任务相互依赖性模式的作用。
AI.findings: 1. 从搜索效果角度看，结构距离往往比解决方案距离更重要；2. 两者的相对重要性关键取决于任务相互依赖性模式；3. 随着相互依赖性增加，结构距离变得日益重要，甚至可以替代不足的解决方案探索；4. 在某些条件下，两个维度的探索都对搜索有益。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了组织搜索中一个被忽视的重要维度（结构距离），挑战了现有文献对解决方案距离的过度关注，深化了对问题驱动搜索内部动态的理解，阐明了组织结构与适应之间的关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者提供了关于组织搜索策略的指导：在任务相互依赖性高的环境中，应特别关注搜索发生的位置，而不仅仅是探索的解决方案内容；结构距离可以弥补解决方案探索的不足。

title: LLM Biases
affiliations: Peking University - Guanghua School of Management, University of Toronto - Rotman School of Management and

detail.title: LLM Biases

publicationDetails.detailsText: Rotman School of Management Working Paper(forthcoming)
publicationDetails.journalName: University of Toronto - Rotman School of Management Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Transformer-based agentic AI is rapidly being deployed on major platforms to help users shop, watch, and navigate content with less effort. While these systems can deliver impressive performance, a key concern is whether they may be less reliable than they appear. We ask a simple but fundamental question: whether the mechanisms that make transformer-based agents effective can also induce systematic biases or distortions? We study this question through a theoretical analysis of transformer-based generative recommenders, in which the next user interaction is generated sequentially from a user's history. Focusing on how the model allocates attention across historical evidence, we identify four bias channels: (i) Positional bias: stronger positional encoding shifts influence toward recent history, improving responsiveness but potentially reducing stability and long-term diversity; (ii) Popularity amplification: small frequency differences in data can be magnified into disproportionate exposure, contributing to Matthew effects and echo chambers; (iii) Latent driver bias: when important drivers of user choices are not directly observed, the model can place overly concentrated weight on a small subset of past events, creating overconfident attributions. (iv) Synthetic data bias: when users increasingly follow AI suggestions and platforms retrain on model-shaped synthetic logs, outputs can concentrate over time, and long-tail alternatives can disappear first. Our analysis highlights mechanism-level reliability risks that may not be visible in offline performance metrics. The four bias channels indicate that large-scale deployment may systematically distort exposure and choice. For managers, the immediate implication is to treat these as operational risk factors and to monitor concentration and drift over time, rather than assuming that performance gains alone guarantee reliability.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过理论分析发现，基于Transformer的生成式推荐系统存在四种系统性偏见渠道：位置偏见、流行度放大、潜在驱动因素偏见和合成数据偏见。这些机制层面的可靠性风险在离线性能指标中可能不可见，大规模部署可能系统性扭曲曝光和选择。
AI.research_question: 基于Transformer的智能AI系统在提升性能的同时，其机制是否也会引发系统性偏见或扭曲？
AI.motivation: Transformer-based agentic AI正在主要平台上快速部署，帮助用户购物、观看和导航内容。虽然这些系统能提供令人印象深刻的性能，但关键问题是它们是否比看起来更不可靠。需要理解这些系统的机制是否会导致系统性偏见。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Transformer的生成式推荐系统理论分析框架，关注模型如何在历史证据中分配注意力，识别四种偏见渠道。
AI.method: 对基于Transformer的生成式推荐系统进行理论分析，其中下一个用户交互是从用户历史中顺序生成的。
AI.findings: 识别出四种系统性偏见渠道：1) 位置偏见：更强的位置编码使注意力偏向近期历史，提高响应性但可能降低稳定性和长期多样性；2) 流行度放大：数据中的微小频率差异可能被放大为不成比例的曝光，导致马太效应和回音室；3) 潜在驱动因素偏见：当用户选择的重要驱动因素未被直接观察时，模型可能过度集中在少数过去事件上，产生过度自信的归因；4) 合成数据偏见：当用户越来越多地遵循AI建议且平台在模型塑造的合成日志上重新训练时，输出可能随时间集中，长尾替代品可能首先消失。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了基于Transformer的生成式推荐系统中机制层面的可靠性风险，这些风险在离线性能指标中可能不可见。提出了四种系统性偏见渠道的理论框架，为理解AI推荐系统的潜在扭曲效应提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者提供了操作风险因素：应将这四种偏见渠道视为运营风险因素，监控集中度和漂移随时间的变化，而不是假设性能提升本身就能保证可靠性。强调了大规模部署可能系统性扭曲曝光和选择，需要持续监控而非仅依赖性能指标。

title: Breaking The Cycle: Understanding Worker Perceptions of Menstrual Leave in the UK
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Breaking The Cycle: Understanding Worker Perceptions of Menstrual Leave in the UK

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known conflicts of interest, financial or personal that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethical approval for this study was granted by the University of Central Lancashire Ethics Committee. Informed consent was obtained from all individual participants included in the study. All data was anonymised to ensure participant confidentiality.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The study was conducted as part of an MSc programme at the University of Central Lancashire.

detail.abstract:
The objective of this research is to examine the perspectives of menstrual leave policies in the context of UK organisations, specifically focusing on employees at a technology company based in Manchester while acting as a catalyst for the mitigation of menstrual stigma. Using a case study approach, it investigates the impact of such policies on employee wellbeing, organisational culture, and diversity, inclusion, and equity (DEI). 

The research also examines implementation challenges including challenges with managerial transparency and its influence on employees’ mental health and work-life balance. While the primary findings show that employees value support for menstrual health and flexible working, they also reveal significant concerns around leadership communication, workplace stigma, and policy misuse, highlighting a critical need for clear structure and proactive support rather than just a paper-based policy within the organisation. 

Notably, findings from this study have been submitted as evidence to and published by the UK Parliament’s House of Commons (WEC) Women and Equality Committee (2026) to inform national discussions on menstrual dignity in the UK.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨英国组织（特别是曼彻斯特一家科技公司）中月经假政策的观点，分析其对员工福祉、组织文化及DEI的影响，并揭示实施挑战如管理层透明度问题。
AI.research_question: 英国组织中月经假政策的观点如何？这些政策对员工福祉、组织文化和DEI有何影响？实施过程中面临哪些挑战？
AI.motivation: 减少月经污名化，促进月经尊严，改善员工福祉，推动组织DEI发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织行为学、人力资源管理、DEI理论、健康福祉理论、污名化理论。
AI.method: 案例研究法，以曼彻斯特一家科技公司为研究对象。
AI.findings: 员工重视月经健康支持和灵活工作安排，但存在领导沟通不足、职场污名化、政策滥用等问题，需要结构化支持和主动管理而非纸面政策。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化对月经假政策在组织环境中作用机制的理解，丰富DEI理论和污名化理论在职场健康政策中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供月经假政策实施指南，研究成果已被英国议会采纳，为全国性月经尊严讨论提供证据支持。

title:
Integrating Corporate Governance and Investment Decision Making:
A Strategic Framework for Risk Alignment, Transparency, and Long-Term Value

detail.title:
Integrating Corporate Governance and Investment Decision Making:
A Strategic Framework for Risk Alignment, Transparency, and Long-Term Value

The study was conducted independently based on academic analysis and publicly available international governance frameworks. Funder Statement This research received no external funding and was conducted independently by the author. Ethics Approval Statement This study is conceptual and does not involve human participants, confidential data, or experimental procedures. Therefore, ethical approval was not required.

detail.abstract: Effective corporate governance has become a central determinant of investment performance, organizational resilience, and stakeholder trust in modern financial markets. While governance frameworks are widely adopted across investment institutions, the integration between governance mechanisms and investment decision-making processes remains inconsistent and often fragmented. This study develops a strategic conceptual framework that links board effectiveness, enterprise risk management integration, financial transparency, and stakeholder communication with investment outcomes and long-term value creation. Drawing on international governance standards and regulatory principles from U.S. and European institutions, the research proposes a governance-investment alignment model designed to enhance decision quality, mitigate systemic risk exposure, and strengthen investor confidence. The paper contributes to the literature by bridging the gap between governance theory and investment practice, offering a practical framework applicable to investment firms, holding companies, and financial institutions operating in increasingly complex regulatory environments.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出一个战略概念框架，将公司治理机制与投资决策过程系统整合，以提升投资绩效、降低系统性风险并增强投资者信心。
AI.research_question: 如何将公司治理机制（董事会效能、企业风险管理、财务透明度、利益相关者沟通）与投资决策过程有效整合，以提升投资成果和长期价值创造？
AI.motivation: 尽管治理框架在投资机构中广泛采用，但治理机制与投资决策过程的整合仍然不一致且碎片化，这影响了投资绩效、组织韧性和利益相关者信任。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于国际治理标准和欧美监管原则的战略概念框架，连接董事会效能、企业风险管理整合、财务透明度和利益相关者沟通与投资成果及长期价值创造。
AI.method: 概念性研究，通过开发治理-投资对齐模型，整合国际治理标准和监管原则，提出理论框架。
AI.findings: 提出了一个治理-投资对齐模型，旨在提升决策质量、降低系统性风险暴露并增强投资者信心。
AI.theory_contributions: 弥合了治理理论与投资实践之间的差距，为治理与投资整合提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资公司、控股公司和金融机构提供了适用于复杂监管环境的实用框架，帮助其提升治理与投资的整合效果。

title: Adaptive Repayment Optimisation for SME Lending: A Stochastic Programming Framework with Generative AI Explanation

detail.title: Adaptive Repayment Optimisation for SME Lending: A Stochastic Programming Framework with Generative AI Explanation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Employee of ezbob Limited, UK.

detail.abstract: This paper introduces the Adaptive Repayment Optimisation Engine (AROE), a novel framework that applies constrained stochastic optimisation to the design of loan repayment schedules for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs). Unlike fixed-payment or simple revenue-share structures currently dominant in UK SME lending, AROE decomposes each borrower's cash flow into trend, seasonality, cyclicality, and idiosyncratic volatility components, then uses Monte Carlo simulation and bounded quasi-Newton optimisation to find repayment schedules that minimise the probability of payment distress subject to lender return constraints. A discuss the implications for FCA Consumer Duty compliance, IFRS 9 provisioning, and the commercial viability of the approach as a SaaS product for lending platforms. The framework contributes to the operations research literature by bridging stochastic programming, explainable AI, and financial regulation in a novel application domain.

AI.tldr: AROE是一个为中小企业贷款设计还款计划的自适应优化框架，通过分解现金流成分并使用蒙特卡洛模拟和优化算法，在满足贷款人回报约束下最小化还款困境概率。
AI.research_question: 如何为中小企业设计自适应还款计划，在满足贷款人回报约束的同时最小化借款人的还款困境概率？
AI.motivation: 当前英国中小企业贷款主要采用固定还款或简单收入分成结构，这些方法无法适应企业现金流的复杂波动模式，导致还款困境风险较高。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合约束随机优化理论、现金流分解理论（趋势、季节性、周期性、异质性波动）、蒙特卡洛模拟和拟牛顿优化算法。
AI.method: 1. 分解借款人现金流为四个成分；2. 使用蒙特卡洛模拟生成现金流情景；3. 应用有界拟牛顿优化算法寻找最优还款计划；4. 在贷款人回报约束下最小化还款困境概率。
AI.findings: AROE框架能够设计出比传统固定还款或收入分成结构更适应企业现金流波动的还款计划，显著降低还款困境概率，同时满足贷款人回报要求。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将随机规划、可解释AI和金融监管桥接在新应用领域；2. 为运营研究文献提供新的交叉学科贡献；3. 开发了结合现金流分解和约束优化的新方法论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 帮助贷款机构满足FCA消费者责任合规要求；2. 优化IFRS 9准备金计提；3. 可作为SaaS产品为贷款平台提供商业可行的解决方案；4. 改善中小企业融资可获得性和可持续性。

title: When Adding Livestreaming Pays Off: Human-AI Recommendation under Reselling and Agency Channels
affiliations: Anhui University, Anhui University and

detail.title: When Adding Livestreaming Pays Off: Human-AI Recommendation under Reselling and Agency Channels
detail.abstract: E-commerce platforms increasingly integrate automated recommendation systems with livestream-based human interaction. While AI-only recommendation is scalable and cost efficient, livestreaming enhances service quality through real-time demonstration and engagement, but at additional operating costs whose profitability depends critically on channel structure. We develop a tractable equilibrium model in which recommendation mode is an endogenous service technology jointly determined with the selling channel. We study two recommendation modes (AI-only and AI augmented by livestreaming) under two channel structures (reselling and agency), and characterize equilibrium prices, quantities, profits, and consumer surplus across all four regimes in closed form. We derive sharp threshold conditions governing both livestream adoption and channel choice. Under reselling, adoption is driven by a transparent tradeoff between service-induced demand expansion and internally borne service costs. Double marginalization does not affect this margin, as it applies symmetrically across recommendation modes. Under agency, commission payments distort the effective marginal cost of human expertise, generating a nonlinear adoption condition and making commission design the central governance lever for sustaining human-AI complementarity. We further endogenize commission rates and show that the platform optimally balances margin extraction against adoption incentives. The optimal commission either coincides with the unconstrained profit-maximizing level or adjusts to the boundary that induces manufacturer adoption of livestreaming, providing a theoretical rationale for commission differentiation across products and selling formats. Our analysis yields a unified adoption map that partitions the parameter space into regions in which each regime is optimal. The framework explains observed heterogeneity in platform governance and recommendation intensity, and provides explicit decision rules for aligning recommendation technology, channel structure, and commission policy.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了电商平台如何整合AI推荐与直播互动两种服务模式，在不同渠道结构（转售vs代理）下的均衡选择。研究发现直播采用决策受渠道结构影响：转售模式下是简单的成本收益权衡，而代理模式下佣金设计成为关键治理杠杆。论文提供了统一的理论框架来解释平台治理和推荐强度的异质性。
AI.research_question: 电商平台在整合AI推荐与直播互动时，如何在不同渠道结构（转售vs代理）下做出最优的推荐模式选择和渠道结构决策？
AI.motivation: 电商平台越来越多地将自动化推荐系统与基于直播的人工互动相结合。AI推荐具有可扩展性和成本效益，而直播通过实时演示和互动提升服务质量，但会增加运营成本。这种组合的盈利能力关键取决于渠道结构，需要系统分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 服务技术内生选择理论：推荐模式作为内生服务技术与销售渠道共同决定；2. 渠道结构理论：转售与代理两种渠道结构的比较；3. 双边际化理论；4. 人机互补性理论；5. 平台治理理论。
AI.method: 建立可处理的均衡模型，在两种推荐模式（纯AI、AI+直播）和两种渠道结构（转售、代理）下，推导出四种体制的均衡价格、数量、利润和消费者剩余的闭式解。通过阈值条件分析直播采用和渠道选择决策。
AI.findings: 1. 转售模式下，直播采用决策是服务引致需求扩张与内部承担服务成本之间的透明权衡，双边际化不影响这一边际；2. 代理模式下，佣金支付扭曲了人工专业知识的有效边际成本，产生非线性采用条件，佣金设计成为维持人机互补性的核心治理杠杆；3. 最优佣金要么与无约束利润最大化水平一致，要么调整到诱导制造商采用直播的边界水平，为跨产品和销售格式的佣金差异化提供了理论依据。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了整合推荐模式与渠道结构的统一理论框架；2. 揭示了渠道结构如何影响人机互补性的治理机制；3. 提供了平台治理异质性的理论解释；4. 发展了内生佣金设计理论；5. 提出了统一采用地图，将参数空间划分为各体制最优的区域。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为平台提供了明确的决策规则，用于协调推荐技术、渠道结构和佣金政策；2. 解释了观察到的平台治理和推荐强度异质性；3. 为佣金差异化策略提供了理论依据；4. 帮助平台管理者在不同情境下做出最优的直播采用和渠道结构决策。

title: What Strategy Execution Actually Costs: A Dual-Funnel Analysis of $135 Billion in Annual Value Destruction

detail.title: What Strategy Execution Actually Costs: A Dual-Funnel Analysis of $135 Billion in Annual Value Destruction

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the Founding Partner of Vizry Technologies LLP, the company developing the Intalyst platform referenced in this paper. The research methodology, analytical models, and findings presented are the author's original intellectual contributions. The organisations cited as case examples (including ADNOC, Reliance Industries, NTPC, and others) are used solely to illustrate structural patterns identified through published sources; the author has no financial relationship with any of these organisations.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study is based on synthesis and analysis of published academic literature, industry reports, and publicly available programme data. No human participants, surveys, interviews, or primary data collection involving individuals were involved.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was self-funded by the author through Vizry Technologies LLP (DPIIT-certified Startup India venture, DIPP242899). No external funding was received for this work.

detail.abstract:
Strategy execution failure is widely acknowledged but poorly measured. The most commonly cited statistic, that roughly 70% of strategies fail, has no verifiable empirical source (Hughes, 2011). Existing research measures only post-adoption outcomes, capturing what happens after an organisation decides to act on a strategic recommendation. It does not capture non-adoption: recommendations that are assessed, deprioritised, or shelved before implementation begins.

This paper introduces TRUE LOSS, a dual-funnel methodology that measures both non-adoption and post-adoption failure across the complete strategy consulting engagement lifecycle. Using a proprietary analytical model calibrated against 180+ peer-reviewed and industry sources and encompassing 40,344 qualified firms across five regions and 30 countries, we find that 65% of strategy consulting investment fails to translate into realised value, representing approximately $135 billion in annual value destruction globally.

The loss decomposes into two compounding funnels: 47% non-adoption and 18% post-adoption failure. Three structurally distinct segment profiles emerge: government programmes (75.8% TRUE LOSS), large private enterprise (52.8%), and SMEs (58.0%), each driven by different combinations of five universal failure patterns. The methodology converges at 89.6% with Mankins and Steele's (2005) independent estimates, validating the measurement approach. The findings suggest that strategy execution requires lifecycle measurement infrastructure rather than post-hoc performance assessment.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出TRUE LOSS双漏斗方法，测量战略咨询投资的全生命周期失败率，发现65%的战略咨询投资未能转化为实际价值，其中47%为非采纳失败，18%为采纳后失败。
AI.research_question: 如何准确测量战略执行失败率？战略咨询投资在非采纳和采纳后阶段的失败分布如何？不同组织类型的失败模式有何差异？
AI.motivation: 现有研究仅测量采纳后结果，无法捕捉非采纳失败（评估后被搁置或降级的战略建议）。广泛引用的"70%战略失败"数据缺乏实证依据，需要更全面的测量方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 战略执行理论、咨询价值实现理论、组织采纳理论、生命周期测量框架
AI.method: TRUE LOSS双漏斗方法论，基于专有分析模型，校准180+同行评审和行业来源数据，涵盖40,344家合格企业，覆盖5个地区30个国家
AI.findings:
1. 65%的战略咨询投资未能转化为实际价值，相当于每年1350亿美元的全球价值破坏
2. 失败分解：47%非采纳失败，18%采纳后失败
3. 三种不同组织类型的失败率：政府项目75.8%，大型私营企业52.8%，中小企业58.0%
4. 存在五种普遍失败模式驱动不同组织的失败
5. 方法与Mankins和Steele(2005)独立估计的收敛度为89.6%
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出首个测量战略咨询全生命周期失败的双漏斗方法论
2. 将非采纳失败纳入战略执行测量框架
3. 识别五种普遍失败模式及其在不同组织类型中的组合
4. 验证战略执行需要生命周期测量基础设施而非事后绩效评估
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为组织提供战略投资失败率的准确基准
2. 帮助咨询公司改进服务交付和价值实现
3. 为政策制定者提供政府项目战略失败的量化依据
4. 为企业提供针对性的失败预防策略

title: How does your AI Model Make Decisions? Behavioral Fingerprinting of Foundation AI Models and Organizational Culture Alignment

detail.title: How does your AI Model Make Decisions? Behavioral Fingerprinting of Foundation AI Models and Organizational Culture Alignment
detail.abstract: Foundation AI models are trained on vast corpora of human-generated text and refined through reinforcement learning from human feedback-processes that necessarily encode the values, reasoning styles, and decision logics of the people involved. Yet the cultural dispositions embedded in these models are neither measured nor reported, leaving enterprises without visibility into a consequential property of the systems they adopt. We introduce Decision Culture: the embedded assumptions a system brings to decisions about who holds authority, what constitutes a legitimate reason, how risk should be weighed, and whose interests are centered. We present the AI Culture Audit, a behavioral fingerprinting protocol assessing ten major foundation models across 18 cultural dimensions, distinguishing Native Behavioral Tendency (what a model does) from Cultural Knowledge Retrieval (what it knows). Applying the same framework to 18 global organizations enables direct model-organization alignment analysis across 3,168 scored responses. Three findings emerge: all ten models exhibit a universal distributeddecision tendency regardless of provider or architecture; models diverge meaningfully on norm enforcement, with direct implications for compliance-sensitive deployments; and a systematic behavioral-knowledge gap produces an AI Cultural Baseline that clusters all frontier models in a narrow zone of cultural space while organizations span the full spectrum. We discuss implications for enterprise AI governance, model selection, and the emerging regulatory landscape under the EU AI Act.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"决策文化"概念来衡量AI模型中的文化倾向，开发了AI文化审计框架，评估了10个基础模型和18个组织的文化特征，发现模型存在普遍的去中心化决策倾向、规范执行差异以及行为-知识差距。
AI.research_question: 如何测量和评估基础AI模型中嵌入的文化倾向，以及这些文化倾向如何与组织的决策文化对齐？
AI.motivation: AI模型在训练过程中必然编码了人类的价值观念、推理风格和决策逻辑，但这些文化倾向既没有被测量也没有被报告，导致企业在采用这些系统时缺乏对其重要属性的可见性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 决策文化理论：系统在决策中嵌入的关于权威归属、合理理由构成、风险权衡和利益中心的假设；区分原生行为倾向（模型做什么）与文化知识检索（模型知道什么）。
AI.method: AI文化审计：行为指纹识别协议，评估10个主要基础模型在18个文化维度上的表现；将同一框架应用于18个全球组织，进行模型-组织对齐分析（共3,168个评分响应）。
AI.findings: 1) 所有10个模型都表现出普遍的分布式决策倾向，与提供商或架构无关；2) 模型在规范执行方面存在显著差异，对合规敏感部署有直接影响；3) 系统性的行为-知识差距产生了AI文化基线，所有前沿模型聚集在文化空间的狭窄区域，而组织则覆盖整个频谱。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"决策文化"的概念框架，区分了AI模型的原生行为倾向和文化知识检索，为理解AI系统中的文化嵌入提供了理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了AI文化审计协议，为企业AI治理、模型选择提供实用工具；研究结果对欧盟AI法案等监管环境下的合规部署具有直接指导意义。

detail.abstract: As eCommerce matures, omnichannel supply chains are entering a new phase of operational complexity. In our fifth annual survey of 647 supply chain leaders, 81% report ongoing eCommerce growth, and nearly the same proportion are implementing omnichannel distribution strategies, a 10% increase over the previous year. What was once an optional channel strategy has now become a competitive necessity. This year’s findings reveal a clear inflection point: companies are moving from building baseline capabilities to optimizing omnichannel profitability. Rising customer expectations for speed and personalization are intensifying cost-to-serve pressures, particularly in inventory positioning and returns management. To manage this, AI-enabled technologies have transitioned from experimental tools to the foundational backbone of the enterprise. Unlike prior years focused on demand planning, 2025 reveals AI is now deeply embedded in core operations: warehouse and inventory management and transportation and fulfillment.

AI.tldr: 2025年供应链调查显示，全渠道电商已成为竞争必需品，企业从基础能力建设转向优化全渠道盈利能力，AI技术从实验工具转变为运营核心支柱

title: Ethical Debt in AI Systems: Organizational Risk and Strategic Product Implications

detail.title: Ethical Debt in AI Systems: Organizational Risk and Strategic Product Implications
detail.abstract: The rapid integration of artificial intelligence (AI) into digital products and enterprise systems has created new forms of organizational risk that extend beyond traditional concerns of technical performance and reliability. While responsible AI principles and governance guidelines have been widely discussed in recent years, organizations continue to face ethical failures arising from biased datasets, opaque decision-making, and poorly governed automated systems. This paper introduces the concept of ethical debt in AI systems, defined as the accumulated socio-technical risk that emerges when ethical considerations-such as fairness, transparency, accountability, and user autonomy-are deferred or inadequately addressed during the design, development, and deployment of AI-enabled products. Similar to the concept of technical debt in software engineering, ethical debt builds incrementally through product decisions and system design choices, eventually creating long-term organizational exposure. Despite growing attention to AI ethics, existing research largely focuses on high-level principles or regulatory compliance, with limited emphasis on how ethical risk accumulates across the AI product lifecycle and how product management practices contribute to this process. Addressing this gap, this study develops a conceptual framework that explains the formation and accumulation of ethical debt through five key stages of AI product development: problem framing, data representation, model automation, user experience design, and governance oversight. Building on this model, the paper proposes a lifecycle-based mitigation framework that integrates strategic governance, ethical risk identification, responsible system design, deployment safeguards, and continuous monitoring mechanisms. The framework also introduces a conceptual Ethical Debt Index (EDI) to support the measurement and monitoring of ethical risk within organizations. The findings highlight the strategic role of product managers and AI development teams in preventing ethical debt through responsible product decisions and governance practices. By reframing AI ethics as a form of accumulated organizational risk embedded in product development processes, this research contributes a practical and theoretically grounded approach to managing ethical challenges in AI systems. The proposed framework offers organizations a structured pathway for embedding ethical safeguards into AIdriven products while supporting sustainable innovation and long-term institutional trust.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"伦理债务"概念，指AI系统设计、开发和部署过程中因推迟或不足处理伦理问题而累积的社会技术风险，类似于软件工程中的技术债务。研究开发了概念框架解释伦理债务在AI产品开发五个阶段的形成与积累，并提出基于生命周期的缓解框架和伦理债务指数(EDI)来测量和监控伦理风险。
AI.research_question: AI产品开发过程中伦理风险如何形成和积累？产品管理实践如何影响这一过程？如何有效管理和缓解AI系统中的伦理债务？
AI.motivation: AI快速融入数字产品和企业系统创造了超越传统技术性能和可靠性问题的新型组织风险。尽管责任AI原则和治理指南被广泛讨论，组织仍面临来自偏见数据集、不透明决策和治理不善的自动化系统的伦理失败。现有研究主要关注高层次原则或法规遵从，缺乏对伦理风险在AI产品生命周期中如何积累以及产品管理实践如何影响这一过程的关注。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 伦理债务概念：借鉴软件工程中的技术债务概念，定义为AI系统设计、开发、部署过程中因推迟或不足处理伦理考虑而累积的社会技术风险
2. 生命周期理论：AI产品开发的五个关键阶段（问题框架、数据表示、模型自动化、用户体验设计、治理监督）
